   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 26, 2026 - Sep 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jonny U_, Sep 6, 2026, 1/5: "App has been working fine until the latest two updates. Now, it reportedly has a bug that stops it from opening. Have tried different work arounds. Cleared the cache, restarted phone, tried online version. To no avail."
            2. _Jan Kvasnicka_, Sep 5, 2026, 1/5: "There are serious tech issues on S26 Ultra. When working in portrait mode it's mostly fine, the only issue is that the S-pen button doesn't work for deletion. But when I flip to landscape mode, the palm rejection stops working, and the rendering gets very slow (letters appear with a lag only after I have lifted the pen). This is making the app almost unusable for me, please fix it, as otherwise I love it. I have 0 issues in other apps, so seems like some software compatibility problems."
            3. _Bart Sikkes_, Aug 31, 2026, 1/5: "After long time use, login issue errir '9hehw', blocking all access in my devices. This appears to be an issue for many, many people over the last few days (latest update) the same issue!! Roll back to.previous version not possible"
